numerical_contract.reason: Quantize only graph admission/order and rank-order decisions so native BLAS/LAPACK noise below manuscript precision cannot change categorical identities; retain unrounded numerical values in evidence tables.

graph.variation_rule: Change tau_c or pi_min one at a time while holding the other at baseline. The shared baseline is archived once per setup/event.

ranking.ablation_rule: Set one coefficient to zero and renormalize the remaining coefficients to sum to one.
ranking.tie_break_rule: Round normalized importance scores to 9 decimal places, then order tied features lexically so platform-level BLAS noise and an ablated term cannot re-enter through tie-breaking.
ranking.droop_rule: Apply the changed ranking weights only inside the structural score; keep the outer structural weight 0.30 and DROOP semantic-prior weight 2.20 fixed.
ranking.jaccard_reference: The full-ranking baseline-graph top-k set for the same setup, event, and data view.
ranking.jaccard_definition: |baseline top-k intersection variant top-k| / |baseline top-k union variant top-k|

evaluation.calibration: Fit feature normalization and configured feature weights on all benign rows after each variant selects its top-k set.
evaluation.blocks: Use non-overlapping blocks within each workload/scenario recording and discard incomplete tails.
evaluation.folds: Reuse the deterministic block-level stratified folds produced with seed 123 for every variant at a fixed operating point.
evaluation.threshold: Estimate the 0.99 quantile from training-fold benign block scores; predict anomaly when score is greater than or equal to the threshold.
evaluation.aggregation: Report the arithmetic mean of workload=ALL fold metrics.

range_membership.graph_parameter: All five unique graph configurations, including the baseline.
range_membership.ranking_term: The four term-removal variants; the baseline is retained only as a reference.
